offering_description.value: Develops and sells enzyme replacement and gene therapies for rare genetic diseases. Sells to specialty distributors, pharmacies and treating physicians, and makes products through its own facilities and contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: enzyme replacement therapies for lysosomal storage disorders; gene therapy for hemophilia A; therapy for phenylketonuria; treatment for achondroplasia

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty distributors, specialty pharmacies, hospitals and treating physicians; B2C: patients with rare genetic diseases who receive the treatments

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription therapies sold to distributors and pharmacies; healthcare reimbursement: payments from insurers and government health programs for treatments

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets its own therapies, sold to distributors and providers; OEM / manufacturer: produces biologic and gene therapy products in-house and via contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: sells in the United States, Europe and other countries worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: enzyme therapies and gene therapies, all for rare genetic diseases

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty distributors that supply treatment centers and pharmacies; direct sales: sales teams calling on hospitals, treatment centers and physicians

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug and gene therapy approvals from FDA and European Medicines Agency, plus pharmaceutical manufacturing rules

notes: Product portfolio and approvals may have changed since my knowledge was last updated.
